label: known_issue
what: A crash or fatal while loading retail stage id 21 or 26 (the unused stages named akaneia and icetop), which have no valid stage or BGM data.
not_for: The Akaneia disc image; any other stage; faults after the stage loaded and played.
examples: FATAL bgm != BGM_Undefined while loading stage=icetop
description: Unused retail stage ids 21 and 26 lack valid stage/BGM data. Applies to the stage identifier, not the Akaneia disc name.

label: mod_content
what: An assertion, panic or refusal raised inside the Geno define loader (pc/geno/geno_define*) while reading a mod's geno.json: the mod's data cannot be built by this build.
not_for: Faults in gameplay code after the define succeeded; Lua script errors; crashes in rendering or audio.

label: script_bug
what: A Lua script of a mod or test harness failed to load or raised an error (nil index, missing global, syntax error). The engine itself kept running.
not_for: Native C assertions, access violations or fatals; failures with no Lua traceback or script load message.
examples: script [ledge-timing/ledge] load: ledge-timing/ledge:19: attempt to index a nil value (global 'os')

label: real_bug
what: A native crash in the game or engine: access violation, unhandled exception, failed C assertion or panic outside the Geno define loader, with no Lua error and no setup problem.
not_for: Aurora/Dawn teardown faults at exit; Lua errors; Geno define failures; unused stage ids 21 and 26.
examples: unhandled exception 0xC0000005 in the logic thread

label: needs_human
what: The signature fits none of the other entries, or it is too thin to tell.

label: harness_artifact
description: A load-induced HANG may be a harness artifact only when BOTH retrace and presented heartbeats advance and there is no fatal/crash evidence. Progress alone does not rule out a real stall earlier in the run.
